title: 16400 - 16400/P0016/000022
models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Setting of Timing Belt

Kontrol edin:  Cam Adjusters as per Repair Manual
technicalNotes:
North American Market (NAR) specific notes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 2009 Audi A4, A5 or Q5 with 3.2FSI AVE Engines, please see TSB 15-09-04.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 2008 and newer VW/Audi 2.0T engine with a timing chain (example; CCTA and CBFA), please see:
Audi Volkswagen - 2.0L Chain Drive - P0016 Cam/Crank correlation check
The photos in this album are from a faulty spool valve (control valve) in a 2012 Jetta with CBFA 2.0T.
TT 01-15-08 for information about the intake camshaft, adjuster bridge and spool valve.
